'''Vee-Six''' was [[Doune]]'s personal droid. He was always at his master's side, and always attempted to curb his master's obsessive [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]]. He was abused verbally by his boss when the [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] got angry.<ref name="TLH" />
